name: Vibe Manufacturing
description: Hosted endpoint for getting hardware prototypes made. An agent describes a product and gets a sourcing plan: parts, make or buy, process per part, matched contract manufacturers from a directory of about 120,000 companies compiled from open data and company websites, and the gaps it cannot cover. After the user confirms, it sends one quote request per make-part and tracks the answers. It can also match a single part spec, list suppliers by country and city and estimate landed cost. No sign-up or key needed.
author: Vibe Manufacturing
